cells.quote: ZSMU was the only institution who reported a significant difference between the groups for Self-Efficacy of Learning Performance, with the mean for the linear group being higher than the branching (p = .001)
cells.note: The study describes the trial as pseudo-randomised and allocated teaching groups as clusters; the reported effect was at ZSMU only.
